tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bar sdings rdzong chung dpon slob byams par gnang ba'i spyi 'gro bzhugs so// shrī sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i yi ge snang srid kyi lha 'dre mi gsum dang / khyad par khri tshang bse grub kyi mi nor phyugs gsum la gnod cing lan chags pa'i gdon bgegs mtha' dag la spring ba/ 'di pa 'khor bcas gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar skyabs su song zhing / dge rgyun sbyin bdag gi gras su gnas pa yin pas/ khyed 'gal byed tshang mas deng phyin chad mi nor phyugs bcas la gnod 'gal logs par 'gro ba spu tsam ma byed par bde bar gnas chug de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba khyed rang gnod byed rnams la 'phral yun gyi phan bde 'byung ba yin/ de las 'das tshe rgyu 'bras bslu med bka' chad 'byung nges pas/ dge sdig las 'bras soms la rdo rje 'dzin pa nged kyi bkod pa bzhin gyis// //zhes dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog pho brang gi yang steng nas 'khon rigs lhag bsam can ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi dkyil 'khor chen por slob ma rjes 'dzin dbang gi PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
